original_description: Tell ChatGPT the movement you want. NoCapMocap checks with you before it makes anything. Watch each version and compare them side by side. For Roblox, download the Studio text file and paste it into RBXMonkey. You can also import any version from Motion Lab History. For Humanoid, choose a standard or Mixamo FBX file.
